description: This file contains asynchronous pytest-based integration tests for the backend API, specifically testing various negative scenarios related to authentication, authorization, security, and data integrity within the dashboard management system.

methods.name: test_integration_auth_missing_token_blocks_write_and_is_auditable(async_client)
methods.description: Tests that requests without an authentication token are rejected with 401 and that audit queries are restricted to authorized roles.

methods.name: test_integration_sod_violation_same_user_submit_and_approve_is_blocked_and_audited(async_client)
methods.description: Verifies that a server-side Segregation of Duties (SoD) violation (user attempting to approve their own submission) results in a 403 and audit query restrictions.

methods.name: test_integration_esign_invalid_signature_hash_is_rejected_and_no_evidence_created(async_client)
methods.description: Checks that an invalid e-signature, specifically with mismatched signer_user_id, is rejected and no evidence package is minted.

methods.name: test_integration_tampered_evidence_checksum_detected_and_flagged(async_client)
methods.description: Ensures that evidence retrieval requires authentication and that non-existent evidence packages return 404, simulating tampered evidence detection.
